name: Triple Constraint
excerpt: The Triple Constraint in project management includes scope, schedule, and cost.
notes: The Triple Constraint in project management refers to the three primary constraints of scope, schedule, and cost. Quality is sometimes included as a fourth constraint, forming a Quadruple Constraint. These constraints are critical in defining project success.
context_summary:
- The Triple Constraint includes scope, schedule, and cost.
- Quality may be a fourth constraint.
- These constraints define project success.
